//: Isolates these functions from the app's `tsconfig.json`.
Without it Deno picks up the root config, which `include`s only `src` and pulls in
no ambient Node types. `deno check` then fails to resolve rather than reporting on
the code, and the usual response is to skip typechecking -- which is how
`recordUsage` ended up typed as `number | null` while every caller passed a promise,
writing a token count of `{}` into every usage row. Nothing caught it because the
functions are not part of the app's typecheck at all.
